# Description lists {#descriptions}

Terms and descriptions own lines by column, like list items. A term follows the continuation rule of every block but the paragraph: after `:: term` only a line indented past the column of the `::` continues it, and an unindented line ends it (C2-B-069, C2-B-076, C2-B-234).

**U-123** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-059 and C2-B-076, `:: term` then `:  intro` then `+` then `  more` writes `more` outside the description in 0.1.

::: compare no-render
```text
:: t
: +
```
```crv
:: t
: {%%}
```
:::

**U-252** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-046, C2-B-067, and C2-H-032, `- [x]   - :: term` followed by indented description lines writes the description at the older list boundary and writes the task item without 0.2 task HTML in 0.1.
Tool: Review the changed description and task HTML.

::: compare no-render
```text

           : desc
           :: next
           : body
```

C2-B-046, C2-B-067, and C2-H-032 change ownership of the nested description and write task item HTML.

**U-378** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A footnote definition inside a definition description, then an indented and an unindented line: `:: t`, `:  [^f]: note`, `     cont`, `tail`. 0.1 writes an empty description; 0.2 keeps the three lines as description text.
Tool: Report from the nested definition opener through the following unprefixed line.

::: compare no-render
```text
:: t
:  [^f]: note
     cont
tail
```
```text
<dl>
  <dt>t</dt>
  <dd>[^f]: note
cont
tail</dd>
</dl> A footnote-shaped definition in a description and its following unprefixed line stay in the description under C2-B-081 and C2-B-083. Report the source range from the nested definition opener through the following unprefixed line.
```
:::

**U-379** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> A comment line under a definition term: `:: c`, `%% note`, `more`. 0.1 ends the list at the comment and `more` is a paragraph; 0.2 skips the comment-only line (C2-B-137), and `more`, which is not indented past the term mark, is a paragraph, as in 0.1 (C2-B-234).
Tool: Report from the comment line through the following retained line.

::: compare no-render
```text
:: c
%% note
more
```
```text
<dl>
  <dt>c</dt>
</dl>
<p>more</p> The comment-only line is not seen (C2-B-137), and `more`, which is not indented past the term mark, ends the term (C2-B-234), so the visible HTML is the 0.1 HTML.
```
:::

**U-387** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A list indented one column past a definition description in a list item: `- :: t`, `  : para`, `   - li`. 0.1 puts the list in the item after the definition list; 0.2 puts it in the description.
Tool: Report from the description marker through the shifted list line.

::: compare no-render
```text
- :: t
  : para
   - li
```
```text
<ul>
  <li>
    <dl>
      <dt>t</dt>
      <dd>
        <p>para</p>
        <ul>
          <li>li</li>
        </ul>
      </dd>
    </dl>
  </li>
</ul> The shifted list line is owned by the description, which gains a paragraph and a child list under C2-B-025 and C2-B-059. Report the source range from the description marker through the shifted list line.
```
:::
